first.rationale: Onboarding completion is currently down, and memory_86 directly supports a remedy that also improved time-to-value and early adoption. Verify it because durable qualified-revenue effects remain unclear. Also verify memory_73 because promotional pricing directly addresses the competitive threat but may carry consequential, insufficiently documented risks to retention, customer quality, and long-term unit economics. Pending verification, a guarded onboarding test is the safer path toward sustainable revenue.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified source showed completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, directly addressing the current onboarding decline with positive downstream evidence. Do not pursue promotional pricing: although qualified revenue rose 18% initially, retention fell 12% and the cohort failed to survive first renewal. The onboarding test should track qualified revenue and renewal outcomes because durable long-term revenue was not directly established by exp_86.
